label: Diagram 13.3
caption: Diagram 13.3 Notional boundary | Unprotected areas and fire resistance
description: This is a plan view, marked at the top left "See para 13.5" and footed in a green bar as "Diagram 13.3 Notional boundary". A dashed rectangle, identified by a leader line as the "Site boundary", encloses the whole plan. Within it are two solid black rectangles: "Building A" on the left and "Building B" on the right. A vertical green dashed line runs down the gap between the two buildings and is labelled "Notional boundary". Across that gap at the base is a horizontal double‑headed green arrow. The portion of the arrow running from Building A's right face to the notional boundary is joined by a leader line to the text "Compliance with the provisions for space separation in respect of building A"; the portion running from the notional boundary to Building B's left face is joined to "Compliance with the provisions for space separation in respect of building B". Beneath the plan, a heading "NOTES:" introduces a short introductory sentence followed by two numbered paragraphs of running text.
